[PREFERENCE] User likes the idea of making homemade granola bars.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided a granola bar recipe with the following ingredients:  
- 2 cups old-fashioned oats  
- 1 cup chopped nuts (almonds, pecans, or walnuts)  
- 1/2 cup nut butter (peanut, almond, or cashew)  
- 1/2 cup honey or maple syrup  
- 1 tsp vanilla extract  
- 1/2 tsp salt  
- 1/2 cup add-ins (chocolate chips, dried fruits, seeds, or coconut flakes)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Instructions for making granola bars include:  
1. Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and line an 8x8 inch baking pan with parchment paper.  
2. Combine oats and chopped nuts in a large mixing bowl.  
3. Whisk together nut butter, honey or maple syrup, vanilla extract, and salt in a separate bowl.  
4
